description: This is a PHPUnit test class for the EmployeeLanguageDao, testing various database operations such as saving, retrieving, searching, counting, deleting, and permission-based retrieval of employee language records within the OrangeHRM project.

classes.name: EmployeeLanguageDaoTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class verifying the functionality of EmployeeLanguageDao, including methods for saving, retrieving, searching, counting, deleting employee language records, and fetching allowed languages for employees.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment, creates an instance of EmployeeLanguageDao, and populates fixture data.

methods.name: testSaveEmployeeLanguage
methods.description: Tests saving a new EmployeeLanguage entity and verifies persistence and associated data.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeLanguage
methods.description: Tests retrieving an EmployeeLanguage by employee, language, and fluency IDs, including null cases.

methods.name: testSearchEmployeeLanguages
methods.description: Tests filtering employee languages by employee number.

methods.name: testGetSearchEmployeeLanguagesCount
methods.description: Tests counting employee language records based on filter parameters.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeLanguagesWithLanguageIds
methods.description: Tests retrieving employee languages filtered by specific language IDs.

methods.name: testDeleteEmployeeLanguages
methods.description: Tests deleting employee language entries and verifies deletion count.

methods.name: testGetAllowedEmployeeLanguages
methods.description: Tests retrieval of permitted languages for specified employees based on their permissions.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeAllowedLicensesCount
methods.description: Tests counting of allowed languages for employees.
